subject: Generate five materially different New Westside design families in Doré Design 1.0
body: Start the first five-family New Westside exploration round now. Use the established learning and current Doré Design 1.0 workspace pipeline. Generate five materially different editor-native designs: Archive Broadsheet, Stone Threshold, Field Notes, Liturgical Sequence, and Luminous Index. These must differ in composition, information architecture, typography/rhythm, material or image strategy, and desktop/mobile behavior—not merely palette. Use real Westside destinations and bilingual content. For every family persist a concise rationale covering hypothesis, why worth testing, prior learning consumed, patterns deliberately rejected, and largest risk. Publish every family as an editable page in the live Doré Design workspace and verify each page is selectable. Verify HTML Preview and HTML Export return HTTP 200 and derive from the same workspace representation. Keep experimental_only=true, product_acceptance=false, style_acceptance=false. Do not mutate the production homepage. Do not promote a winner. Preserve existing editor pages and Journal invariants. If the current editor node model cannot express a materially different family, extend the editor model rather than flattening all concepts into the same text/rule/block grammar. Complete the whole round autonomously; repair local runtime or permissions if needed; return only after all five families and their rationales are live and verified.
